children: Overview
Italy mineral supplement maker's H1 2026 revenue rose 17.9% yr/yr
EBITDA for H1 2026 grew 6.2% yr/yr, net profit up 8.1%
Growth driven by international markets and flagship products, new units grew 102% yr/yr
Outlook
Company expects new business units to drive further growth and profitability
PharmaNutra sees international markets as key growth drivers for future development
Result Drivers
INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION - Revenue from foreign markets rose 34.8% yr/yr, accounting for 38.6% of total revenue
NEW BUSINESS UNITS - New business units contributed about EUR 5 mln to total revenue, up 102% yr/yr
FLAGSHIP PRODUCT GROWTH - SiderAL line sales grew 19.6%, with additional strong growth from Cetilar (+18.3%), Apportal (+12.9%) and Sidevit B12 (+67.6%)
